Calendar_PluginDesc: Shows the month with lunar dates, statutory holidays and make-up workdays, and reminds you at the times you set for any day.
Calendar_ProviderDesc: Opens a month-view calendar with lunar dates, solar terms, holidays and make-up days.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_CalendarInstantProvider: Opens the month-view calendar with lunar dates, holidays and reminders.
Calendar_TextProviderDesc: Supplies the lunar date, solar terms and festivals for the quick window's clock line.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_CalendarTranslationProv: Provides UI translations and localization resources for the Calendar plugin.
Calendar_Config_TriggerDesc: Type this word in the search box to open the calendar.
Calendar_Config_FirstDayDesc: Which day the weekday header and the month grid start from.
Calendar_Config_LunarDesc: What the second line under each date shows.
Calendar_Config_HolidaysLabel: Show statutory holidays and make-up days
Calendar_Config_HolidaysDesc: Marks each date with an Off or Work badge.
Calendar_Config_DurationDesc: Seconds each reminder stays on screen. A value outside what the notification's position allows is clipped to its bounds.
Calendar_Config_TestDesc: Adds a reminder due immediately and runs the whole delivery path, so you can confirm reminders actually reach you.
Calendar_NoHolidayData: Holiday arrangements for this year have not been announced yet
